notes:
Account summary:
- Mid-market SaaS (customer support platform for SMB+ mid-market customers). 220 employees, support org ~48 agents.
- Primary objective: replace current in-house assistant with a hosted LLM-backed chat agent to surface KB, draft replies, and call internal tools (ticket triage, macros).
- Current evaluation path: hosted API POC -> consider Dedicated for predictable latency & throughput if economics and SLOs hold.

Technical requirements / constraints:
- Workload: live chat agent + async reranking for suggested replies. Heavy streaming requirement (agent UI expects partial tokens).
- Latency SLO: first-token p95 < 1.5s for US region (primary), p50 target ~0.6s.
- Throughput target: peak ~150 concurrent agents, ~200 requests/sec baseline for peak business hours.
- Tooling: function-calling to Zendesk + internal ticket microservices, must support structured function responses.
- Caching: want prefix/KV caching on repeated follow-ups to reduce cost & latency.
- Model preference: open-models acceptable if latency/cost tradeoffs are good; interested in Redwood-verified recommended model profiles.

Security & compliance:
- Must pass SOC2-like checklist; SSO via SAML (Okta); audit logs and retention 1 year; KMS integration for key management; data residency US-only.
- Internal SecOps raised questions on third-party data caching — want option to disable persistent caches for PII threads.
